book.name: Mɛsɔ natelaa Zaŋ ɛ
book.title: Mɛkana mɛ Etɛp e syela Sisim Étɛp natel Zaŋ ɛ Étɛp ɛ Sisim Zaŋ nabee

content: Moma bɛ dhalagɔŋ
Boo ndem wat naazɛtuula tɔ gwoo: dhiiti moma naabɔt gwyes é nyel dáa kaad, ngɔn nabɛ ɛ́ si mɛko mɛ, nyɛ nadi ɛ́ nɛ kɔtɔ bɛghɛŋ na ekwyikwyen kam nɛ bɛbá kɔ lo.
Nyɛ nadi ɛ́ nɛ ɛbum. Tin, ɛbɛl nadi esa náá, nyɛ tsim ɛlyelɛpe.
Tin, wɔ gwak dhiiti ndem sis baazɛtuula tɔ gwoo, ye nabɛ ɛ́ boo dhalaghɔŋ
na tɔɔbelaa dáa du. Nyɛ nadi ɛ́ nɛ elo etɛn nɛ ebá, nɛ melak kam. Tin, kɔ elo etɛn nɛ ebá binek, ye nadi ɛ́ nɛ ekɔtɔ bɛghɛŋ etɛn nɛ ebá.

Deenek, ɛkɛɛz ɛ lɛ nadi ewaabal ɛdhuu ɛ ekwyikwyen wat tɔ mɛdhuu mɛlɛl nadi tɔ gwoo ɔ, wɔ gwak ye mwas bɛ kɔ bɔs. Dhaalagɔŋ tak natyaŋ ɛ sok bhwoob moma nadi ekwyɛl ɛbya ɔ, étɛp nyɛ needɛ mɔn tak é ghɛŋ nyɛ aabyel ɛ.
Tin, moma tak naazɛbya mɔn motom. Mɔn tak ɛ́ waadjɛɛd bot ɛ membyak djas nɛ sek ghwooz. Mɔn tak naazɛbyet tɔ́ pɛ daa Zɛɛb, pɛ bóó mɛkoozi mɛ di ɛ.

Yɛ kabɛ moma ɔɔ, nyɛ naazɛkaab tɔ́, pɛ kyee dik bɛsyɛ di ààbɛ nɛ mɛdii ɛ, pɛ pak Zɛɛb nazekoobal nyɛ di ɛ, étɛp nyɛ needjɛaa edee mɛlu mil wat nɛ mɛlu bɛdhet ɛbá nɛ mɛkam-mɛtɛn nɛ kam wat (1 260).
Bhii tak, tuub naazɛduel tɔ gwoo. Kukuma efofop Mesɛl nɛ efofop bɛ naaduu nɛ dhaalagɔŋ. Tin, dhaalagɔŋ naabaangamela pɛ yɛ kyee nɛ bɛ efofop.
Tin, ye nabɛ ɛ́ bɛ naakwak dhaalagɔŋ bɛ nɛ efofop bɛ. Bɛ nabɛ ɛ́ ààkabɛ nɛ di ɛdi tɔ gwoo.
Tin, boo dhalaghɔŋ naazyeegelaa mwasaa pɛ si. Ye ɛ́ nyɛy ɛ́ di nyɔ na mwa. Nyɛy ɛ́ di edjóoaa dim nɛghu Satan mot di esa náá bot ɛ bɔs wo ze ɔ. Bɛ naazemwas nyɛ bɛ nɛ efofop bɛ kɔ ɛko ɛ bɔs.

Bhii tak, mɛ eezɛgwak gwood wat ekim ɛlyelɛpe tɔ gwoo, eke náá: «Nenak, ye moo ɛ́ ɛwala ɛ Zɛɛb di etsik bot ɛ! Nenak, Zɛɛb'enaka eelyaal mɛbwala mɛ, nyɛ eesa náá, ɛyoŋ ɛ lɛ di. Nenak, mɛkoozi mɛ ɛ́ tɔ mɛmbɔ ɛ Mɛsia. Etɛɛ náá, nyɛ naazedis mot di epit bɔn nyɛɛg bina mwos nɛ pum tɔ gwoo ɔ, mwas nyɛ pɛ si.
Bɔn nyɛɛg bena eekwak nyɛ dum nɛ ghiya mɔn bhata nɛ mɛkpa mɛ bɛ di egoola ɛ. Bɛ nabɛ ɛ́ ààkwyɛɛg mɛnyel mɔɔ, bɛ naamyam ɛgel mɛnyel mɔɔ.

Étɛp tak ɛ di náá, dika tɔ mɛmyaala, wɔy gwoo nɛ biyɔ bot ɛ di tɔ gwoo ɔ! Yɛ kabɛ wɔy bɔs nɛ boo dii mɛsɔn ɔ, kpaa-ghoŋ nɛ nen! Dim moo ɛ́ kɔ len, nɛ ɛbuk dhaa tyɛ, etɛɛ náá, nyɛ nɛ gu náá, mɛlu mɛ kɔ ɛko ɛ bɔs kalik ɛ́ batsa!»
Dáa dhalaghɔŋ nabee náá, nyɛ naazyeegelaa, mwasaa kɔ ɛko ɛ bɔs ɛ, wɔ gwak nyɛ zɛdu moma nabya mɔn motom ɔ.

Tin, moma naazɛdjɛaa eboo mɛbhap mɛmbá yii bhyel. Ye nabɛ ɛ́ étɛp nyɛ neepilal, kɛkum edi bɛ nazekobal nyɛ yɛ ɛ pɛ kyee dik bɛsyɛ di ààbɛ nɛ mɛdii ɛ. É di nyɛ aadjɛaa edee membu mɛlɛl nɛ pes ààkuna nɛ nyɔ ɔ.
Wɔ gwak nyɔ tak zɛgo dhoo mɛdii nɛ mɛdii ɛbuɛpe dáa dii djaa bhii koŋ moma yenɔk étɛp moma neewo tɔ mɛdii mɛ tak.
Tin, wɔ gwak, bɔs zokazyɛ zɛtsik moma. Bɔs eezɛbɛɛ nuub, min bɛtɛ nɛ mɛdii mɛ dhalaghɔŋ nago tɔ nuub'ɛ djas.
Tin, dhalaghɔŋ nazɛpkaa ɛbuk nɛ moma, wɔ gwak, nyɛ zɛtɔ́ kɛlumla dɛɛb nɛ bɛdhiiti bɔn moma di elooba nɛ mɛtiŋ ɛ Zɛɛb, nɛ ɛdi ɛ sosoob nɛ etsɛɛtsɛ e bhaadal ɛ Yezu ɔ.
É di'enek, dhalaghɔŋ nazɛtɔ́ kɛtyaa é ngwoob bɛsyɛ boo dii mɛsɔn.
